title: Does DPO Training Exhibit Emergent Misalignment? Comparing RLHF and DPO Under Narrow Misaligned Fine-Tuning

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Directly compares the safety properties of the two dominant alignment paradigms under a well-defined threat model. Clear implications for which alignment approach to prefer.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires running both DPO and RLHF alignment pipelines, then fine-tuning both on insecure-code data. Running RLHF (PPO) is particularly complex and compute-intensive. Not beginner-friendly even with TRL.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Two full alignment pipelines (DPO + RLHF) plus misalignment fine-tuning plus evaluation. This is effectively three projects. Far too broad for 30 hours.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
